title: First green master ci.yml: hub importable in integration partition + regenerated #169
command: gh run view --log-failed diagnosis + ci.yml/agentic-fabric.yml repair + push
output_excerpt: Root cause proven from run 35791445157 logs: pyproject pytest pythonpath=['src'] shadows the installed wheel, so the compiled __autofde_lab_hub_cpp never resolves (test_pomcp collection error). Fix: materialize the .so from the exact-SHA wheel into src/autofde_lab/hub before the partition runs; same build for agentic-fabric court. Baseline honesty: master ci.yml was 0/306 green BEFORE this lane (pre-existing). #169 regeneration and the first green run are pending.
